definitions.dark: a one-photon block whose ideal algebra-mode probability p_algebra is 0: x y = 0, so the photon leaves only through the dilation ports and any algebra-mode detection is implementation error
definitions.bright: a one-photon block with p_algebra = 1: ||x y||^2 = 2, so the photon never reaches a dilation port
definitions.half: a strut, non-kite or four-label block with p_algebra = 1/2, independent of the signs s and t

preregistered.observable: per block, the fraction a of detected samples whose photon lands on an algebra mode (roles other than dilation), counted on the samples with exactly one click inside the block; the full per-mode histogram is kept, since the dilation split carries the direction of y in the kernel
preregistered.ideal: a equals the block's p_algebra; the per-mode ideal is the exact |U[k][0]|^2 of circuit.json
preregistered.simulator_stop_rule: on sim:belenos, any algebra-mode sample of a dark block or dilation-mode sample of a bright block, or a half block outside |z| < 4.5 of its binomial, stops the series until the circuit, the compiler or the simulator's noise model explains it
preregistered.hardware_report: on qpu:belenos, the dark floor a_dark, the bright ceiling a_bright, the contrast a_bright - a_dark, the total variation distance of each per-mode histogram from its ideal and the one-hot leakage into the 14 unreachable labels, each with a Wilson 95% interval and the dark counts of the detectors involved
preregistered.layout: blocks share a job and a block-diagonal unitary; inter-block crosstalk is a variable the single series lacks, and the block on modes 4-7 reads mode 5 (38.2 dark counts per second in the retained record) as label_1, a floor near 4e-3 of its samples
